name: application-terminal-blocks
title: Terminal Blocks
description: Original terminal and code-output blocks for install commands, test runs, and deploy scripts, in three levels of detail.
useWhen: Original terminal and code-output blocks for install commands, test runs, and deploy scripts, in three levels of detail.
avoidWhen: Avoid terminal blocks when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Terminal Blocks uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
